title: Amazon Prime Video to Broadcast Games Locally for Six NHL Teams, Including Carolina
dek: Amazon Prime Video will be the exclusive local streaming home for six NHL teams, Carolina, Anaheim, Columbus, Dallas, Minnesota, and St. Louis, under a multiyear agreement announced by the league on September 2. The deal includes pre- and post-game coverage for each team.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Prime Video becomes the exclusive local streaming broadcaster for six NHL teams, with the defending Stanley Cup champion Hurricanes among the first to launch their own broadcast service through the platform.
bottom_line: Six NHL teams now have a direct streaming pipeline to their markets; the outcome of how quickly fans migrate to these Prime Video services and whether other NHL teams follow suit will determine whether this model becomes the league's standard for local broadcasting.
body:
Amazon Prime Video will be the exclusive local streaming home of six NHL teams under a multiyear agreement announced by the league on September 2, according to Yahoo NHL. The teams are Carolina, Anaheim, Columbus, Dallas, Minnesota, and St. Louis.
Carolina is the defending Stanley Cup champion. The agreement includes pre- and post-game coverage for each team. Charlie Neiman, Prime Video head of sports partnerships, stated per the reporting: "We're excited to build upon our strong relationship with the NHL and provide fans with more ways to connect with the local teams they love."
The St. Louis Blues will join the Ducks, Hurricanes, Blue Jackets, Wild, and Stars in the Prime Video streaming arrangement. The Minnesota Wild announced Prime Video streaming prices and launch of Wild+ Network as part of the broader deal.
The agreement positions Prime Video as a direct local broadcast competitor to traditional cable and regional sports networks. Each team has developed its own branded streaming service accessible through the Prime Video platform, marking a shift toward team-owned streaming operations rather than reliance on third-party cable distributors.
